name: Black Sabbath

whyMatters.en: Birmingham four-piece whose 1970 debut fixed tritone riffs, down-tuned guitar, and occult-tinged lyric as heavy metal’s separable identity from hard rock.
whyMatters.zh: 伯明翰四人组：1970 首专把三全音 riff、降调吉他与偏神秘歌词定为重金属相对 hard rock 可分离的身份。

note.en: Tritone riff + slow tempo as early metal scene.
note.zh: 三全音 riff + 慢速度作为早期金属场景。

note.en: Short/fast heavy single that still fits radio.
note.zh: 仍适合电台的短快重型单曲。

interviewQuotes.text: We knew we had something different.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Tony Iommi

lyricQuotes: What is this that stands before me?

shortBio.en: Iommi / Osbourne / Butler / Ward; Paranoid-era metal foundation.
shortBio.zh: Iommi / Osbourne / Butler / Ward；Paranoid 时期金属地基。

body.en:
Formed 1968. Black Sabbath, Paranoid, and Master of Reality document Iommi’s riff writing after fingertip injury (lighter strings, fretting adaptations), Geezer’s bass/lyrics, Ozzy’s nasal lead, Ward’s drums.

Title track Black Sabbath (1970) and Paranoid / Iron Man are the teaching set. Dio-era Heaven and Hell is a separate vocal-engine version under the same name.
body.zh:
1968 年组建。Black Sabbath、Paranoid 与 Master of Reality 记录 Iommi 指伤后的 riff 写作（更细弦、按弦适应）、Geezer 贝斯/歌词、Ozzy 鼻音主唱、Ward 鼓。

同名曲 Black Sabbath（1970）与 Paranoid / Iron Man 是教材组。Dio 时期 Heaven and Hell 是同名下另一套人声引擎版本。

title.en: A riff catalog, not mascara hard rock
title.zh: riff 目录，而非涂睫毛膏的 hard rock

body.en:
Sabbath matter because heaviness is arrangement and interval choice—tritone, slow tempo, bleak lyric—not only louder amps.

Metal gets a separable grammar from blues-based hard rock here.
body.zh:
Sabbath 要紧，因为「重」是编曲与音程选择——三全音、慢速度、阴郁歌词——不只是更大的音箱。

金属在此获得相对蓝调 hard rock 可分离的语法。

title.zh: Ozzy 年代 vs Dio 年代

body.en:
Ozzy-era peak is the birth citation. Dio’s Heaven and Hell reinvents vocal and fantasy lyric without erasing the riff engine.

Same logo, different singer—why lineup versions are first-class objects.
body.zh:
Ozzy 时期巅峰是创世引用。Dio 的 Heaven and Hell 重做人声与奇幻歌词，不擦掉 riff 引擎。

同一 logo、不同主唱——故阵容版本是一等对象。

body.en:
Rain/bell intro into Iommi’s tritone figure; Ozzy’s vocal enters over the dread tempo. Often cited as metal’s creation-scene track.

Atmosphere is tempo + interval, not stage fog metaphor.
body.zh:
雨声/钟声引入 Iommi 三全音音型；Ozzy 人声进入恐惧速度。常被引为金属创世场景曲。

氛围是速度+音程，不是舞台烟雾比喻。

body.en:
Faster riff, tighter runtime, still heavy. Proof early metal can fit AM/FM without losing the down-tuned grind.

Teaching contrast to the title track’s crawl.
body.zh:
更快 riff、更紧时长，仍然重。证明早期金属可进 AM/FM 而不丢掉降调碾磨。

与同名曲爬行速度的教学对照。

body.en:
Doom keeps the slow dread; NWOBHM keeps riff primacy at higher speed; Seattle grunge cites the sludge more than the occult.

Black sun as catalog influence, not astrology.
body.zh:
Doom 留下慢恐惧；NWOBHM 以更高速度保持 riff 优先；西雅图 grunge 更多引用淤泥而非神秘学。

黑太阳是目录影响，不是占星。

title.en: They called it heavy; catalogs called it metal
title.zh: 他们称它重；目录称它金属

body.en:
Early press language lags the genre label. Useful quotes describe volume, gloom, and audience shock—genre name arrives in retrospect.

Track the naming lag as history.
body.zh:
早期媒体用语落后于类型标签。有用引语描述音量、阴郁与听众震惊——类型名事后到来。

把命名滞后当作历史追踪。

note.zh: 创始 Ozzy 时期巅峰阵容。

note.en: Same band name, Dio vocal engine—versions matter.
note.zh: 同名、Dio 人声引擎——版本要紧。

note.en: Tritone opening as metal creation citation.
note.zh: 三全音开场作为金属创世引用。

note.en: Heaviness as interval, tempo, and lyric frame—not only volume.
note.zh: 「重」作为音程、速度与歌词框架——不只是音量。
